mapper.select: SELECT * FROM system_data_email_history WHERE system_data_email_history_setting_id = #{settingId} AND system_data_email_history_labels LIKE CONCAT('%', #{label}, '%') ORDER BY system_data_email_history_received_date DESC
SELECT * FROM system_data_email_history WHERE system_data_email_history_setting_id = #{settingId} AND system_data_email_history_is_read = false ORDER BY system_data_email_history_received_date DESC
SELECT * FROM system_data_email_history WHERE system_data_email_history_setting_id = #{settingId} AND system_data_email_history_is_starred = true ORDER BY system_data_email_history_received_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE system_data_email_history SET system_data_email_history_sync_status = #{syncStatus}, system_data_email_history_error_message = #{errorMessage}, system_data_email_history_sync_time = NOW() WHERE system_data_email_history_id = #{id}
